description.value: Pink Peppercorn Seafood House is a fine-dining seafood restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, well regarded for fresh, ethically sourced ingredients including wild-caught salmon, Nova Scotia lobster, and free-range chicken. The menu blends classic West Coast preparations with creative chef-driven dishes, and the intimate décor is pitched toward special-occasion dining. Takeout is also available for those eating on the go.
